job.title: Sr. Cyber Defense Engineer
job.description:
The ITS Cyber Defense Senior Specialist is a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert who strengthens the organization’s cyber defense posture through a blend of Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, and security engineering expertise. This role protects enterprise information systems and data from intentional or accidental destruction, disruption, or modification while minimizing the impact on those who need legitimate access to systems, files, networks, and data. The position independently leads and executes complex cybersecurity initiatives from planning through implementation, improves defensive controls and processes, drives detection and response activities for advanced threats, and serves as a trusted technical resource across IT, business teams, and external partners.

The role works closely across IT teams and business units to identify security gaps, define requirements, recommend solutions, and communicate risks, status, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. Provides expert-level consulting, leadership, and escalation support in the identification, analysis, mitigation, and escalation of security risks, anomalies, vulnerabilities, events, and incidents to the Manager, ITS Cyber Defense, in accordance with established procedures. This position is accountable for timely incident handling, detailed case management documentation, advanced analysis of security alerts and threat intelligence, processing of mitigations, and escalation of confirmed or suspected threat activity.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as a senior subject matter expert and escalation point for Cyber Defense, providing technical leadership and mentorship to team members.
  • Monitors, analyzes, investigates, and responds to security alerts and events across endpoint, network, identity, email, and cloud environments using enterprise security tools.
  • Performs alert triage and case management, including validating events, distinguishing false positives from true threats, documenting findings, assessing impact, and escalating in accordance with established procedures.
  • Supports and leads incident response activities, including scoping, evidence review, forensic support, documentation, containment actions, and escalation into formal incident response processes.
  • Administers and improves Cyber Defense technologies such as EDR, SIEM, NAC, vulnerability management tools, and other monitoring and control platforms, including tuning, troubleshooting, upgrades, and optimization.
  • Leads detection and response improvements by tuning alerts, reducing false positives, identifying visibility gaps, and implementing enhancements to tools, processes, and workflows.
  • Independently manages technical and operational improvement initiatives, including tool enhancements, process optimization, and reporting improvements, while communicating progress to stakeholders.
  • Partners with internal teams and external vendors to support troubleshooting, remediation, tool effectiveness, and implementation of Cyber Defense capabilities.
  • Contributes to the development and enhancement of Cyber Defense policies, standards, procedures, and compliance alignment with regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Participates in the IT Security on-call rotation and responds to high-priority events and incidents as required.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in information technology, information security, or risk-related roles.
  • 5+ years of direct cybersecurity experience in areas such as security operations, incident response, cyber defense, detection engineering, or related security disciplines.

  • Experience independently managing complex technical work, coordinating across teams, and driving security initiatives from assessment through implementation.

  • Availability to support after-hours or on-call activities if needed for incident response, security events, or critical business requirements.

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, or equivalent are preferred.
  • Working knowledge of applicable cybersecurity and privacy frameworks, standards, and regulations, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF), SOX, HIPAA, and NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500.

job.title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (Contract/Remote)
job.description:
Platform Operations & Tooling Engineer (Full Time, Long-Term Contract;Remote)

Optomi, in partnership with one of our clients, is seeking a Platform Operations and Tooling Engineer to support the development, modernization, and automation of enterprise platforms used by software development teams. This role will focus on designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating AWS cloud infrastructure, managing artifact repositories, and improving developer workflows through scalable and reusable solutions. The Platform Operations and Tooling Engineer will leverage technologies such as TeamCity, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, and Kubernetes to enhance platform reliability, security, and operational efficiency. This individual will collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to troubleshoot complex build and deployment issues, implement automation, and support ongoing platform improvements. The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience in DevOps and platform engineering, strong AWS and infrastructure-as-code expertise, and excellent troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Build, automate, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform, Ansible, Packer, and infrastructure-as-code best practices.
  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise CI/CD pipelines using TeamCity, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, and related development tools to streamline software delivery.
  • Develop reusable automation scripts, GitHub Actions workflows, and infrastructure modules to standardize deployment processes and improve developer productivity.
  • Configure, administer, and optimize artifact repositories, source control systems, and build environments to ensure reliable and secure software delivery.
  • Support containerized applications and cloud platforms using Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, Helm, and Argo CD, including platform modernization and migration initiatives.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to troubleshoot complex build, deployment, and integration issues while implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Improve platform reliability, security, and operational efficiency through monitoring, automation, documentation, technical guidance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Apply today if your background includes:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, platform engineering, CI/CD, and enterprise software development environments.
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting enterprise CI/CD pipelines using TeamCity, GitHub Actions, and related development tools.
  • Extensive experience designing, deploying, and supporting AWS cloud infrastructure, including infrastructure automation and cloud security best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration management tools, including Terraform, Ansible, and Packer.
  • Experience configuring and administering JFrog Artifactory, including artifact repositories, permissions, authentication, and artifact management processes.
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, Helm, and Argo CD for containerization, orchestration, and automated application deployments.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, and YAML, with demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and collaborating across development, infrastructure, and security teams.

job.title: Production Support Engineer
job.description:
Production Support Engineer (Remote)

Optomi, in partnership with a leading provider of embedded software solutions, is seeking a Senior Product Support Engineer to provide advanced technical support across embedded software technologies and customer environments. This role will troubleshoot complex software and system-level issues, perform root cause analysis, manage technical escalations, reproduce customer environments, and collaborate with engineering and product teams to drive resolution. The ideal candidate brings strong technical troubleshooting skills, customer-facing experience, and the ability to support enterprise customers and mission-critical deployments.

What the Right Candidate Will Enjoy:

  • Serving as a technical expert for enterprise customers and technical stakeholders!
  • Troubleshooting complex issues across embedded systems, operating systems, virtualization, and cloud environments!
  • Collaborating with software engineering and product teams to resolve technical challenges!
  • Mentoring junior support engineers and sharing technical knowledge!
  • Working remotely with flexible hours and potential travel opportunities!

Experience of the Right Candidate:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–8 years of experience supporting or developing embedded systems, RTOS, Linux, cloud platforms, or related technologies.
  • 3–5 years of customer-facing technical support experience.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex software and system-level issues.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customers and collaborating with technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with software engineering and product organizations.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide advanced technical support for embedded software products and related technologies.
  • Manage technical incidents, escalations, and defect investigations.
  • Investigate, reproduce, and troubleshoot complex customer issues across software and system environments.
  • Perform root cause analysis across hardware, operating systems, networking, virtualization, and cloud layers.
  • Develop and communicate technical solutions, workarounds, and remediation recommendations.
  • Partner with software engineering and product teams to investigate defects and drive resolution.
  • Maintain clear customer communication, including technical findings, status updates, and resolution plans.
  • Support strategic enterprise customers and mission-critical deployments.
  • Share technical expertise and mentor junior support engineers as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Wind River products and technologies.
  • Familiarity with VxWorks RTOS and Wind River Linux.
  • Experience with WRCP, HVP, Simics, or Wind River Linux.
  • Experience with OpenStack and Kubernetes deployments.
  • Background supporting aerospace, defense, telecommunications, industrial, or embedded software customers.
  • Experience as a Premium Support Engineer or designated technical account resource.
  • Active security clearance is a plus, but not required.
